shots.prompt: At the Glacier Borehole Site, an exposed high-altitude glacier plateau features polished blue ice, sweeping wind sastrugi, and panoramic mountain nunataks. Dr. Elena Vance, a 38-year-old woman with a lean athletic build, pale windburned skin, dark hazel eyes, and dark brown hair, wears a bright red high-altitude parka, black insulated salopettes, bulky black polar expedition boots, a white fleece balaclava, and tinted polarized glacier goggles. Astrid Lind, a 29-year-old Nordic woman with a tall wiry build, fair freckled skin, and clear blue eyes, has long blonde twin braids and wears a teal expedition snowsuit, yellow climbing boots, and a yellow pompom knit cap. The Motorized Core Drill, an assembled tubular aluminum-and-steel tripod frame with motorized cable winch and rotary head, stands with clean polished aluminum legs bolted over the blue ice borehole. Elena grips the throttle cable while Astrid checks the winch tension to power up the rig against the biting morning wind. Wide eye-level shot framed against distant granite peaks.
